timeline.evidenceText: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.
and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;
and Beriah, and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

Ezra the scribe stood on a pulpit of wood, which they had made for the purpose; and beside him stood Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah, on his right hand; and on his left hand, Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hashbaddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam.

definitions.short: Shema , the name of a place in Palestine and of four Israelites
definitions.full: H8087. Shema ' II. שֶׁ֫מַע proper name, masculine usually Σαμα ( α ), Σεμαα (compare Sabean proper name סמע Hal 509 ); — 1 in Judah 1Chr 2:44 , שָׁ֑מַע 2:43 . 2 in Reuben 1Chr 5:8 . 3 in Benjamin 1Chr 8:13 (= שִׁמְעִי 8:21 ). 4 post-exilic Neh 8:4 , Σαμαιας .
